author: Mike Staley
title: Columbia Gas of Virginia to replace gas lines in Staunton - NewsBreak
text:
By Mike Staley ,
13 hours ago STAUNTON, Va. (WHSV) - Drivers and residents of the city of Staunton can expect to see utility crews around Gypsy Hill Park for the next year. According to Columbia Gas, over 15,000 feet worth of piping will be replaced around the neighborhoods north of Gypsy Hill Park. Stephanie Benson, spokesperson for Columbia Gas of Virginia, said residents who are in the construction plan should have received a letter in the mail detailing any disruptions to their natural gas utilities.
